propositions: Vendor-specific lazy-load keys for Jira ADF and comment limits are hardcoded in backend-neutral core modules (outbound_comments.py, inbound_translate.py), causing vendor code to execute on non-Jira backends.
Rich-text normalization on the inbound apply path must defend against raw ADF dicts reaching EDIT event descriptions without being decoded to text (bug 1bb2-5da5).
Comment-diff dedup must normalize both ADF-dict and string bodies to comparable text form, and must truncate comments to backend-specific limits without emitting send-side warnings.
Vendor literal-key references must be eliminated from core modules and routed through port-layer roles (FieldSanitizer and InboundMapper) to satisfy the backend-separation goal of epic bbf1.

The outbound comment-diff decode and the inbound apply decode both use the same vendor transformation (adf_to_text), so they must share a single backend-routed surface (InboundMapper.normalize_rich_text).
Literal-key sweep test with single recorded exemption (inbound_fields.py) must fail if any other core module contains the adapters.jira string literal.
